Rule 8: an import that cannot be followed makes the closure indeterminate, and such a record is never reused. The edit is a behavior-neutral comment in src/plugins/volume.ts, a file every defender runs but only through that computed import: a reuse that hashes the static closure only would carry every answer forward.
